symbols.name: chunk bound
symbols.meaning: The largest number of equal-width address chunks that one layer acts on, a count.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the largest number of equal-width chunks a layer acts on, and $D \le d$ is the number used in one layer; the letter $D$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: chunks per layer
symbols.meaning: The number of selected equal-width address chunks used in one layer, a count, at most d.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the largest number of equal-width chunks a layer acts on, and $D \le d$ is the number used in one layer; the letter $D$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: layer exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one in the layer's cost bound, so that the cost grows in d more slowly than d itself.
symbols.quote: Here $\lambda'$ is a fixed exponent below one.

relations.quote: A simultaneous butterfly layer applies the [butterfly operation](butterfly-operation.md) to one selected address bit of every record at once.

The layer computes its chunk moves by the [linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), which carries each input role to an output role with a prescribed sign and restores every auxiliary value.

The layer is formed as the [tensor product](tensor-product.md) of $D$ copies of the butterfly operation, one for each selected bit, acting on each coefficient and leaving the other address bits unchanged.
